insights.one_liner: Child safety and lifestyle brand making car seats and strollers; its Amsterdam marketing internship requires Dutch and it is not a recognised sponsor.

culture.text: Makes car seats, baby carriers, kids furniture and strollers, and positions itself as a lifestyle and fashion brand for parents.
Describes itself as always questioning the status quo and challenging the establishment.

open.text: Its one current opening, a marketing internship in Amsterdam, asks for Dutch.
Not listed as an IND recognised sponsor.

growth.text: Says it has grown rapidly in the last few years and is looking for ambitious talent.
